The Petition was heard through video conferencing on 6.12.2022 and during the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner circulated note of arguments and made detailed oral submissions. Accordingly, the Commission after hearing the parties, permitted the Respondents to file their written submissions (not exceeding three pages), to the note of arguments of the Petitioner made during the hearing and accordingly, reserved its order in the matter. In response, the Respondent TANGEDCO has filed its written submissions on 27.12.2022 and the Petitioner has filed its response to the same on 10.1.2023.
